# Franchise Architect: Football

Franchise Architect: Football is a proprietary football franchise management game by VaultSpark Studios LLC. It runs entirely in the browser, with no account and no install, and is free in early access. It uses no AI services: rivals, the Front Office Advisor and league news are computed by the game's own rules.

Canonical URL: https://playfranchisearchitect.com/
Contact: football@playfranchisearchitect.com
Rights: Proprietary - All Rights Reserved, VaultSpark Studios LLC.

Useful paths:
- / - browser game (start page)
- /features.html - feature tour with screenshots
- /how-to-play.html - how a season works, from week one to the draft
- /faq.html - frequently asked questions: early access, saves, privacy, challenge codes, commissioner mode, system requirements
- /roadmap.html - where the game is heading, stated as intentions without dates
- /simulation.html - what the football simulation is measured against, and the stated limits of that anchor
- /about.html - about the game and the studio's principles
- /press.html - press kit: fact sheet, boilerplate, screenshots, logo, mark, cover image
- /status.html - latest dated release notes
- /status-archive.html - changelog: every dated release note (also at /changelog.html)
- /changelog.xml - RSS feed of the changelog
- /contact.html - project contact and bug reports
- /privacy.html - privacy notice
- /terms.html - terms and rights notice
- /agents.json - machine-readable agent metadata
- /content/claims.json - machine-readable feature list and fact sheet (the source the website copy is rendered from)
- /stats - human-readable Community Stats
- https://api-franchise-architect-football.vaultsparkstudios.com/community/v1/snapshot - machine-readable aggregate snapshot
- /stats-surface.json - stats contract and methodology descriptor
- /llms.txt - this file (also at /.well-known/llms.txt)

Starting a league from a link:
- /?challenge=weekly - this calendar week's shared league. Everyone who opens it in the same ISO week (UTC) gets the same seed and the same club.
- /?challenge=<code> - one exact league from a challenge code. A code looks like VSFC1.<base64url JSON>.<4-character checksum>; the JSON holds s (seed), y (start year), t (club id) and, optionally, rs (seasons to a title to beat) and rn (challenger name). A code with a wrong checksum is rejected, not repaired.
The link fills in the start page; the visitor still presses Create League. Nothing is sent to a server.

Reading a running franchise (co-gm-briefing, version 1.0):
The player can copy or download a briefing of their franchise from the in-game Co-GM panel (/game.html#coGmBriefPanel). It is JSON with kind "co-gm-briefing" and these top-level fields: authority (teamId, teamName, year, week, phase, record), currentCommand (the decision the game is waiting on), pressure (ownerMandate, ownerTrend, ownerHeat, capSpace, controlledTeamInjuries, rosterNeeds, leagueHeadline), architectThesis (the player's stated plan and any pending adaptation) and a record of recent decisions. It carries only what the player can already see in the game: no save data, no hidden ratings, no personal details. Nothing is exported unless the player asks.

Headless simulation (for developers and agents with the source):
node src/index.js --years <seasons> --seed <integer> --startYear <year> --export --outDir <folder>
runs whole seasons without the browser. The same seed gives the same league. With --export it writes league-summary.json (meta, champions, history), team-season-table.json, player-season-tables.json, player-career-tables.json, records.json, players-active.json and players-retired.json.
